study.name: Retest: H11 Single-Pass 384px T=0.0 (corrected)
study.description:
Corrected rerun of single-pass-384 at T=0.0. Original runs executed at T=1.0 due to the same config propagation bug as consensus-384 (temperature from JSON config overrode the YAML-specified T=0.0).
Uses full_evaluation_manifest (487 tiles) to match all consensus and PV analyses. The 240-tile validation subset can be derived post-hoc by clipping to validation_bounds.geojson.
study.retest_notes: T=1.0 bug correction. Original single-pass-384 used detect_brief-text.json which has temperature: 1.0 hardcoded. The YAML specified T=0.0 in fixed and carried_forward sections, but the config file default was applied instead. This rerun uses explicit temperature: 0.0 in conditions to ensure the CLI --temperature flag is passed.
